findings.statement: CA9 transcripts in the tumor are held by RCC cells: 97.6% share of tissue transcripts (0.976), 54.7% of RCC cells expressing, cpm_share 0.958; the signal is tumor-intrinsic.

Paired by donor, CA9 is higher in RCC cells than in proximal tubule (log2FC 7.739, padj 0.0189, 6 donors; PT mean log2CPM 0.0). Bulk RNA log2FC 6.312 extrapolates to 7.787 at purity 1, so it is not infiltration.

In Visium, CA9 high spots are enriched for RCC neighbours (log2 enrichment 0.377, padj 0.00173; observed 0.4751 vs expected 0.3658). Composition-corrected share of in situ expression is 0.998 for RCC.

The best CA9 glue site (KAA) scores MGD 0.546, with volume 126.8 A3, pocket pLDDT 90.3 and 1 accessible lysine. Ligand-site recall is 0.5 overall but 0.221 in the top pockets, and mean model pLDDT is 76.56. This is a site worth exploring, not a glue. CA9 is already targeted by girentuximab (Phase 3).

CA9 ranks first in convergence (score 4.5197, 5 streams); TCGA log2FC is 9.712 and protein log2FC 2.269. DepMap mean effect in ccRCC is 0.051 (no dependency), and Cox log HR is -0.009 (no prognostic value).
KDR is an endothelial gene: 95.1% of tumor transcripts (0.951), 40.5% of endothelial cells expressing, cpm_share 0.979. It is a microenvironment (anti-angiogenic) target, not a tumor-cell target.

CD74 is expressed by antigen-presenting and immune cells, not tumor cells. cDC show 100% expressing cells with cpm_share 0.311, and macrophages hold 0.436 of tumor transcripts. CD8 T cells hold 0.345 of transcripts at 95.5% expressing. Bulk signal is infiltrate-driven.
CXCR4 is lymphoid: CD8 T cells hold 0.563 of tumor transcripts (72.9% expressing) and CD4 T cells show 87.8% expressing, cpm_share 0.17. It is an immune-cell target, not a tumor-cell target.

CD70 ranks 3rd in convergence. It is tumor-intrinsic: bulk RNA log2FC 4.464 holds at purity 1 (4.278). TCGA log2FC is 7.09 and protein log2FC 2.421. Clinical-stage CD70 antibodies exist (Phase 1-2). DepMap effect is 0.251, so there is no dependency evidence. Structure analysis is not available.

NNMT ranks 7th in convergence. RNA log2FC is 4.67 (5.256 at purity 1) and protein log2FC 2.709, so the signal is tumor-intrinsic. TCGA Cox log HR is 0.301 (padj 0.00479). It has no clinical drug in the graph.

ALDOB is a loss-type biomarker: RNA log2FC -7.028 (-6.302 at purity 1) and protein log2FC -2.273, consistent with loss of the proximal tubule program. It ranks 2nd in convergence and is not a tumor-cell target.

COL23A1 is a first-in-class tumor-track candidate (novelty 0.839). RCC cells hold 0.881 of tumor transcripts (17.1% expressing, cpm_share 0.65). RNA log2FC is 4.07 and protein log2FC 2.51. It has 7 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, and AB and PR tractability. Vital-organ expression is low (3 nTPM, heart muscle). Caveat: no dependency evidence, and literature is counted by gene symbol.
COL23A1 is a poor glue candidate: mean pLDDT 58.91, only 0.13 confident residues, and a best site of 8.0 A3 (MGD 0.2342). Ligand validation was not run.

RAB42 is a tumor-track first-in-class candidate (novelty 0.775). RCC cells hold 0.627 of transcripts. RNA log2FC is 3.11 and protein log2FC 1.9. It has 2 ccRCC papers and no clinical drug, and vital-organ expression is low (2.6 nTPM, lung). The model is confident (pLDDT 85.31) and the best site scores MGD 0.5348, but the pocket is small (37.4 A3, 3 accessible lysines) and unvalidated. Caveat: no functional evidence.

LRRC25 is an immune-track candidate carried by macrophages (0.787 of tumor transcripts), with novelty 0.704 and 0 ccRCC papers. It has no clinical drug. Protein log2FC is 1.48 and grade rho 0.34. Bone marrow expression is 31 nTPM, which is an off-tumor risk. Best site MGD 0.4825 (43.0 A3, pLDDT 93.9, 2 lysines), with mean model pLDDT 70.31. This is a macrophage microenvironment hypothesis.

OLFML2A is a stroma-track candidate carried by fibroblasts (0.647 of transcripts). It has 2 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug and AB tractability. RNA log2FC is 1.62 and protein log2FC 1.07. Colon expression is 27.9 nTPM, which is an off-tumor concern. The effect is modest and there is no functional evidence.

GAL3ST4 is an immune-track candidate (novelty 0.711) carried by macrophages (0.972 of transcripts). It has 1 ccRCC paper, no clinical drug and AB tractability. Protein log2FC is 0.91, and vital-organ expression is 7.4 nTPM (cerebral cortex). It is a hypothesis only.

caveats: Discovery candidates are data-ranked hypotheses with no dependency or functional evidence; literature is counted by gene symbol.
MGD scores rank sites, not glues; pockets are small and ligand-site validation is missing for most discovery genes.
CD70 and NNMT cell-type rows had no evidence ids, so their cell-type values are not quoted; their tumor-intrinsic call rests on bulk purity extrapolation.
EPAS1, MET and EGFR were not examined within the call budget.
DepMap effects are weak for the top genes, so none has dependency support.
